error.missing_dependencies: systemctl, systemd-run, systemd-inhibit and sleep are required.
error.state_mismatch: The inhibitor did not end up in the requested state.

auto_off.body: You are back, so suspend and lid-close work normally again.
auto_off.title: Away mode off

off.body: Suspend and lid-close work normally again.
off.title: Away mode off

on.body: Nothing will suspend this machine until you turn it off. Locking and screen-off still work.
on.title: Away mode on

auto_off_on_unlock.description: Turn away mode off by itself once you unlock the session, so normal suspend comes back without a second click
auto_off_on_unlock.label: Turn Off When You Return

lock_on_enable.description: Lock the session as soon as away mode is turned on
lock_on_enable.label: Lock On Enable

mute_on_enable.description: Mute the speakers as soon as away mode is turned on; turning it off unmutes them again, unless they were already muted when you left
mute_on_enable.label: Mute On Enable

screen_off_on_enable.description: Turn the screens off as soon as away mode is turned on; they wake normally on input or lid-open, and go dark again on the usual idle timer
screen_off_on_enable.label: Screens Off On Enable

tooltip.off: Away mode off — click before you step away
